title: Seven-Day Free Test Results
purpose: One simple, fixed-business, fixed-test results report; not the broader operations or paid-conversion dashboards.

rules.crm_baseline: Verified field metadata plus an immutable, server-bound pre-test CRM snapshot; business-supplied values remain context, not measured improvement.
rules.unknown: Missing evidence stays Not available. Do not turn absent analysis or baseline values into zero.
rules.call_mix: Six exhaustive groups sum to unique handled calls. Urgency and follow-up are overlapping flags, not additional slices.
rules.time_zone: Daily source trend is explicitly UTC; no unverified local-time relabeling.
rules.value: No recovered revenue, bookings, cost savings, or before/after uplift is inferred from call counts or average job value.
rules.delivery: Operator reviews the reconciled report and exact owner-approved recipient; no automatic email, public link, embed, or schedule is enabled.
rules.legacy: Do not modify the broader dashboard contract, legacy tables, paid-conversion gates, historical rows, or consumed approvals.
rules.cost: Reuse canonical facts without query tables or new dashboards. Live target capacity, schema, access, sync binding, and cost still require readback.
